capability.summary: Preview the first 800 units of a Tablib export
capability.description: Reads one input file as UTF-8 text, lets Tablib load the dataset with format inference, exports it to a requested format defaulting to JSON, and returns only the first 800 characters or bytes under output.
capability.problem_space: Short previews of Tablib dataset exports from UTF-8 text-based tabular inputs.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: UTF-8 text input path and Tablib export-format name; output: JSON with output containing only the first 800 exported characters or bytes.
accepted_inputs: a UTF-8 text file whose format Tablib Dataset.load can infer
an export format identifier supported by the installed Tablib format registry
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.tablib_convert", and output as the first at most 800 characters of a text export or, for binary exporters, the shared JSON emitter's string representation of the first at most 800 bytes. A caught UTF-8 read, input-format detection, dataset-load, or export exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.tablib_convert", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: does not write a converted file and returns only the first 800 units of the export despite the file artifact declaration
always opens input as UTF-8 text, so binary source formats such as XLSX cannot be loaded correctly by this wrapper
does not accept an explicit input format and relies on Tablib's automatic detection
binary export formats yield sliced bytes that the shared JSON emitter stringifies rather than returning a usable binary artifact
the wrapper defaults a missing target format to json even though the manifest declares it required
decoding, format detection, import, and export errors use the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: At-most-800-unit preview of a Tablib export; no converted file is written or returned.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: convert UTF-8 tabular text and inspect the beginning
negative_intents: produce a complete converted dataset file
return usable binary XLSX or ODS export bytes
